app_summary: The application implements a hotel reservation service, built with Go and gRPC. The initial project is extended in several ways, including adding back-end in-memory and persistent databases, adding a recommender system for obtaining hotel recommendations, and adding the functionality to place a hotel reservation.
RCA_gt: The `profile` deployment is rewritten so its container command is `geo` instead of `profile`; AIOpsLab deletes and reapplies the deployment with that modified command. The profile pod therefore starts the wrong service binary.
_source_comment: Ground truth source: AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/wrong_bin_usage/wrong_bin_usage.py (faulty_service); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/generators/fault/inject_virtual.py (container command changed from profile to geo and deployment reapplied); AIOpsLab/aiopslab/orchestrator/problems/registry.py (problem ID).
